messages:
Marta (PM): Short sync: we need to finalize MVP cutlist today. Two enterprise asks (SSO + dedicated routing) are high risk. I propose pilot-only SSO and push dedicated routing to v1. Agree?
Drew (Eng): Agreed. Dedicated routing requires routing table changes and rollout logic. Risky for public MVP.
Sana (SRE): Ops backing this. If we merge routing now we risk cascading throttles in some regions. Pilot-only SSO behind flag is safer.
Eli (Sales): Pilot customers can accept SSO behind flag if onboarding is fast. They want timeline: can we enable within 10 business days after flag lands?
Drew (Eng): Yes — once flag + basic isolation exist we can onboard in ~7-10 business days. Need SE docs.
Kara (Design): If SSO is pilot-only, UX needs to hide flows for public users and show a clear "Request enterprise access" CTA. I can drop copy + banner.
Marta (PM): Action items: 1) Marta: update roadmap + public MVP one-pager (today). 2) Drew: feature-flag PR for SSO (by Wed). 3) Sana: add canary + rollback checklist (post-PR). 4) Kara: banner + CTA copy (tomorrow). 5) Eli: notify pilots and collect signoffs (by Fri).
deploy-bot: Canary started on public-mvp-branch: 5% regions for 24h.
Marta (PM): We'll reconvene Thu 11am to review canary metrics and pilot acceptances. If any pilot absolutely needs routing, escalate and we'll consider a narrow exception.
Eli (Sales): I'll flag requests immediately.
Drew (Eng): Posting PR link when ready.
Marta (PM): Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
